voice.text: Hey, need some furniture for your house? Come to the Plank and Treasurechest Market!

parameter.value: Welcome to the Plank and Treasurechest Market, |PLAYERNAME|! Best offers in town!
Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture.
I run this market and sell furniture.
This is the best city in the whole world! We don't care about greedy kings or ambitious priests and the like ...
Sorry, I have none of those.
